question: WACA Cricket Ground is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Perth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The WACA (Western Australian Cricket Association) Ground is a sports stadium in Perth, Western Australia.
 
• It has been the "home of cricket" in Western Australia since the early 1890s.
 
• The ground is located in the suburb of East Perth and is named after the association that owns it.
 
• The WACA Ground has hosted Test matches, One Day Internationals, and Twenty20 Internationals as well as other sports events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of the WACA Ground:**

 
 
• The WACA Ground was officially opened in 1893, making it one of the oldest cricket grounds in Australia.
 
• It has undergone several renovations and expansions over the years to accommodate larger crowds and modern facilities.
 
• The ground is known for its fast and bouncy pitch, which has made it a favorite venue for fast bowlers.
 
 
 
• **Major Events at the WACA:**
 
 
• The WACA Ground has hosted numerous memorable cricket matches, including Test matches, ODIs, and T20Is.
 
• Some of the most famous cricketing moments have taken place at the WACA, including record-breaking performances by players like Dennis Lillee, Glenn McGrath, and Adam Gilchrist.
 
 
 
• **Other Uses of the WACA Ground:**
 
 
• Apart from cricket, the WACA Ground has also been used for Australian Rules Football, rugby, and soccer matches.
 
• The venue has hosted concerts and other cultural events, making it a multipurpose facility.
 
 
 
• **Future of the WACA Ground:**
 
 
• In recent years, the WACA Ground has seen a decline in international cricket matches being hosted there, with the newer Perth Stadium taking over many of these events.
 
• However, the WACA Ground continues to be an important venue for domestic cricket and remains a significant part of Western Australia's sporting heritage.
